production.routeOrWindow: SMTP: confirmation link and weekly report emails
interfaces: Subscription UI (not in this directory): the approved prototype is the main prototype, designs/rivu-svelte/src/routes/account/WeeklyReportsCard.svelte (account page card) and designs/rivu-svelte/src/routes/auth/WeeklyConfirmPage.svelte (signed-out page at /weekly-report/confirm/{token}); the owner approved it on 2026-11-19. Production implements it in apps/dashboard/src/routes/(app)/account/WeeklyReportsCard.svelte and apps/dashboard/src/routes/(auth)/weekly-report/confirm/[token]/+page.svelte; the backend is bin/rivu/src/weekly_report.rs (docs/architecture/platform-and-ops.md#周报订阅接口). The old standalone settings page and its confirmation-code flow were removed from this directory.

Production sends both emails as multipart/alternative, plain text first and HTML second (crates/mail/src/weekly_report.rs builds the two parts, crates/mail/src/lib.rs Mailer::message assembles the message). Invitations and password resets stay text/plain. The Current plain text version reproduces the subjects and plain-text bodies production sends, and it is byte for byte the Plain text version of this design; verify.cjs asserts both.

Confirmation email in production (crates/mail/src/weekly_report.rs confirmation, sent from bin/rivu/src/weekly_report.rs): the mailbox is confirmed once per account through a link, not a code. Subject 确认接收 Rivu 周报 / Confirm your email for Rivu weekly reports. Plain text: one explanatory sentence, a blank line, the label and the link {RIVU_BASE_URL without trailing slashes}/weekly-report/confirm/{token}, a blank line, the validity sentence (one hour, single use), a blank line, the ignore line. HTML: heading, the sentence, one confirm button, the validity sentence and the ignore line in the footer. No unsubscribe link and no List-Unsubscribe headers.

Opening the confirmation link changes nothing: the page behind it (GET /api/weekly-report/confirm/{token}) only checks the token, and its button confirms (POST), so mail clients that prefetch links cannot confirm for the user. A wrong, used, expired or superseded link answers 404. Requesting a new confirmation email makes the earlier link invalid. A request is limited to one per account per minute.

Implemented unsubscribe (bin/rivu/src/weekly_report.rs, crates/mail/src/lib.rs): every weekly report carries the per-send unsubscribe link in the footer of both parts (退订周报 / Unsubscribe), and the SMTP message carries List-Unsubscribe: <{url}> and List-Unsubscribe-Post: List-Unsubscribe=One-Click (RFC 8058). The endpoint unsubscribes on POST and ignores the body, so a mailbox provider's one-click POST works; GET only shows the confirmation page.

The link is {RIVU_BASE_URL without trailing slashes}/api/weekly-report/unsubscribe/{token}; the dashboard link uses the same base, {base}/s/{site_id}. A new 43-character base64url token is generated for each send record; only its SHA-256 hash is stored (weekly_report_claims.unsubscribe_hash), bound to the user, the site and the confirmation time of that subscription. The link has no time limit and stops working once that site's subscription is off or subscribed again.

Unsubscribe pages (production, unstyled, not redesigned here): GET only shows a confirmation page, so a client that previews mail links cannot unsubscribe anyone; POST turns off the subscription for that one site. No sign-in and no cookie are involved, and a malformed token answers 404. The pages are fixed bilingual HTML (lang=en, Chinese in lang=zh paragraphs) that does not follow the email language, served with Content-Security-Policy default-src 'none'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none', so they cannot carry styles, scripts or images. Copy: confirmation page title Unsubscribe · Rivu, heading Unsubscribe from Rivu weekly reports, line 退订 Rivu 周报, button Unsubscribe · 退订; success You have unsubscribed from Rivu weekly reports for this site. / 你已退订此站点的 Rivu 周报。; expired or already off This link has expired or the subscription is already off. / 退订链接已过期，或订阅已关闭。 The unsubscribe-page-current state shows these three pages as served; the form is inert in the preview.

Unsubscribing deletes that site's subscription row and keeps the send records used for de-duplication. It does not touch the confirmed mailbox or the other sites; the user can turn the site on again from the account page. A link from before a re-subscribe stays dead because the new subscription has a different confirmation time.

Production evidence for the unsubscribe flow: internal_api.rs weekly_report_rechecks_recipients_and_claims_survive_restart (the body carries the List-Unsubscribe URL, GET leaves the subscription active, POST answers You have unsubscribed, a stale link answers already off, removing a member deletes the subscription while send records stay) and crates/mail/src/lib.rs smtp_message_contains_a_list_unsubscribe_uri.

Implemented as designed: HTML is table-based with inline styles, no scripts, images or remote resources, well under 100 KB, with a dark scheme under prefers-color-scheme. Every interpolated value is HTML-escaped, and a site name or time zone is collapsed to a single line (control characters become spaces, 200 characters at most) before it is used in the subject and the plain-text part.

Copy as implemented, all from data the sender already has: the report subject names the site and the week; numbers use thousands separators; dates are written out in the email language (the subject omits the year unless the week crosses a year boundary); the link text uses the dashboard term 看板; a week without any visit adds one line saying so.

Confirmation email as implemented (HTML and plain text, both languages): a heading (确认接收周报 / Confirm your email), one explanatory sentence (确认用这个邮箱接收 Rivu 周报。 / Confirm that Rivu weekly reports should be sent to this address.), one confirm action (确认邮箱 / Confirm email), the validity sentence and the ignore line.

Footer of the report as implemented: the reason for the email with the recipient address, a Manage weekly report link to {base}/account (the account page holds the mailbox confirmation and the per-site switches), and the unsubscribe link.

Report data is exactly what deliver() queries: site name, period from/to, site time zone, visitors, visits, pageviews, and {base}/s/{site_id}; the unsubscribe token is generated separately. No comparison with the previous week is shown because none is queried. The report email and the unsubscribe pages are unchanged by the move of the subscription to the account page.
